interpretation_decisions.decided_by: project owner via explicit session approval
interpretation_decisions.effective_scope: Domestic 400NG Item 28A extra-pickup shadow rating only for the 2026 rate cycle, 2026-05-15 through 2027-05-14. Authorizes the 12 August 2022 DOM_400NG row 23 fields R, 28A, EA, SC, AB, Origin PPSO, and Yes only when combined with the current 2026 400NG eligibility text and 2026 Baseline Rates cell Additional Rates!A13:F13.
interpretation_decisions.excluded_scope: Does not approve the complete 2022 item-code workbook for 2026, invoice-line acceptance or rejection outside Item 28A, Item 28B or 28C, SIT, other accessorials, or any later rate cycle.
interpretation_decisions.rationale: The 2026 400NG expressly incorporates the official Item Code Listing for rate-date behavior and independently names Item 28A; the applicable 2026 Baseline Rates independently names 28A and supplies 198.50 USD per occurrence; the archived official library snapshot retrieved 2026-08-03 still offers the exact 12 August 2022 listing; and no contrary Item 28A source is archived. The project owner approved this narrow continuation inference while retaining the broader publication-location conflict.
required_regression_tests: rate date before, on, and after each 2026 rate-cycle boundary
zero, one, and multiple completed eligible extra-pickup occurrences
self-storage-only exclusion
missing Government authorization or missing completion evidence
duplicate occurrence and duplicate evidence rejection
exact-decimal multiplication and result provenance tampering

interpretation_decisions.decided_by: project owner via explicit agreement with recommended Alternative A
interpretation_decisions.effective_scope: Domestic 400NG Item 28B extra-delivery shadow rating only for 2026-05-15 through 2027-05-14. Authorizes actual pickup date and DOM_400NG row 24 fields A, 28B, EA, SC, AE, Destination PPSO, and Yes with current Item 28 eligibility and Additional Rates!A13:F13.
interpretation_decisions.excluded_scope: Does not approve broad CF-0001 or CF-0003 resolution, Item 28A or 28C, stop-off transportation, related services, SIT, broad item-code validation, later cycles, live submission, or money movement.
interpretation_decisions.rationale: Specific tariff Item 1.2(c) and row 24 support actual pickup date over the general workbook banner within this narrow scope; current tariff and rate sources independently name Item 28B and its rate; the archived official library still links the exact listing; and no contrary Item 28B source is archived.
required_regression_tests: requested and actual dates across both rate-cycle boundaries
zero one and multiple completed extra deliveries before final delivery
final delivery and unperformed stops excluded
both Government authorization channels and Destination PPSO evidence
duplicate occurrence approval and evidence rejection
exact Decimal multiplication and contract provenance result tampering

interpretation_decisions.decided_by: project owner via explicit session approval of Decision 0006 Alternative A
interpretation_decisions.effective_scope: Domestic 400NG Items 4.5 and 4.13 tolerance-branch eligibility only for actual pickup dates 2026-05-15 through 2027-05-14. The final reviewed initial net scale weight selects the at-or-below-5,000-pound versus over-5,000-pound branch; exactly 5,000 pounds uses the at-or-below branch.
interpretation_decisions.excluded_scope: Does not authorize a reweigh-fee rate, Item 226A or another billing-code contract, discount treatment, reimbursement/refund/charge-allocation amounts, constructive-only substitution, later cycles, live submission, external communication, or money movement; CF-0001 and CF-0003 remain open.
interpretation_decisions.rationale: The tariff does not expressly name the branch fact. Initial net is the narrow approved interpretation because it exists before both decisions, is an explicit Item 4.5 operand, remains stable across later observations, and avoids making branch selection depend on the result being tested. Advisory 23-0004 applies lesser-weight invoicing only after tolerance qualification and therefore does not select the branch.
required_regression_tests: selector exactly 5,000 uses at-or-below branch
candidate selectors on opposing sides of 5,000
equal or higher reweigh qualifies without tolerance
fee exact 150 is not less than 150
fee exact 5 percent is not less than 5 percent
fee just below 150 and 5 percent
reimbursement requires new tare greater than original tare
reimbursement exact 150 is not more than 150
reimbursement exact 5 percent is at least 5 percent
reimbursement just above 150 and just below 5 percent
exact Decimal arithmetic without rounding
missing conflicting unreviewed or blocked initial net stops the decision
source decision and result tamper rejection

rules.expression: candidate_rate_table_date := actual_pickup_date
candidate_transit_source := SV-DP3-2026-TRANSIT-2025-12-08
candidate_authorized_sit_days := ROUND(transit_days * 0.7, 0)
candidate_item_code_source := SV-DP3-ITEM-CODES-2022-08-12
item_28a_contract := requested_pickup_date_basis + EA_unit + SC_rate_reference + AB_additional_pickup_location + origin_ppso_approval_required for 2026 Item 28A only
eligible_occurrence := completed_extra_pickup_after_first AND origin_ppso_approved_before_performance AND reviewed_approval_and_completion_evidence AND NOT self_storage_only
expected_amount_usd := eligible_item_28a_occurrence_count * 198.50 USD_per_occurrence; no rounding
item_28b_contract := actual_pickup_date_basis + EA_unit + SC_rate_reference + AE_additional_delivery_location + destination_ppso_approval_required for 2026 Item 28B only
candidate_eligible_occurrence := completed_additional_delivery_before_final AND government_authorized AND reviewed_authorization_and_completion_evidence
candidate_expected_amount_usd := eligible_item_28b_occurrence_count * 198.50 USD_per_occurrence; no rounding
net_weight_lb := gross_weight_lb - tare_weight_lb
vehicle_scale OR ((platform_scale OR warehouse_scale) AND (containerized_at_no_additional_cost OR net_weight_lb <= 1000))
same_vehicle_or_container AND (non_vehicle_scale OR (equipment_consistent AND vehicle_unoccupied AND compliant_fuel_state))
all_determining_tickets_present AND all_required_fields_present AND certified_scales AND combined_ticket_only_if_same_scale
(grade_band = E1_THRU_E5 AND initial_weight_lb >= 4000) OR (grade_band IN (E6_THRU_O10, DOW_CIVILIAN) AND initial_weight_lb >= 7000)
selected_reweigh_net_lb := MIN(net_weight_lb for each current completed reweigh observation version with reviewed ticket evidence and complete DPS update)
lower_weight_reference_lb := MIN(final_initial_net_scale_weight_lb, final_lowest_current_completed_reweigh_net_lb)
constructive_weight_lb := verified_volume_cu_ft * 7 lb_per_cu_ft; no rounding applied
constructive_reference_lb := valid_ticket_available ? MIN(final_valid_ticket_weight_lb, constructive_weight_lb) : constructive_weight_lb
provisional_net_weight_lb := new_gross_weight_lb - original_tare_weight_lb; no rounding applied
containerized_provisional_reference_lb := MIN(final_initial_net_scale_weight_lb, final_containerized_provisional_net_weight_lb)
supplemental_refund_required := reweigh_after_initial_invoice_submission AND lower_completed_reweigh_selected
hold_release_ready := dps_reweigh_update_complete AND ppso_ticket_delivery_complete AND (NOT supplemental_refund_required OR refund_submitted_and_processed)
qualifies := reweigh_net >= initial_net OR (initial_net <= 5000 AND initial_net - reweigh_net < 150) OR (initial_net > 5000 AND initial_net - reweigh_net < lower_net * 0.05); no rounding
required := reweigh_tare > original_tare AND ((initial_net <= 5000 AND reweigh_tare - original_tare > 150) OR (initial_net > 5000 AND reweigh_tare - original_tare >= lower_tare * 0.05)); no rounding
